source_note: Hand-built sample set — real, currently-existing course titles and providers, written from general knowledge (not scraped or fetched live). Fallback for the missing Coursera/Udemy MCP connectors, per user instruction. Treat as representative, not verbatim listings. estimated_hours is a rough hand estimate for path-fitting purposes, not a scraped/official figure. Added for the multi-role rework (see CLAUDE.md) alongside seed_data_scientist.json and seed_frontend_developer.json. Course ids are suffixed with '-mle' where a similarly-named course also appears in another role's seed file, to keep every id unique across the whole knowledge base.

courses.title: Machine Learning Engineering for Production (MLOps) Specialization
courses.description: Covers designing, deploying, and monitoring production ML systems: data pipelines, model serving, and TensorFlow Extended (TFX).

courses.title: DeepLearning.AI TensorFlow Developer Professional Certificate
courses.description: Hands-on TensorFlow training covering computer vision, natural language processing, and time series forecasting.

courses.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning Bootcamp
courses.description: A hands-on introduction to building and training neural networks with PyTorch, from tensors through computer vision models.

courses.title: Docker and Kubernetes: The Complete Guide
courses.description: Covers containerizing applications with Docker and orchestrating them with Kubernetes, including deployments, services, and scaling.

courses.title: Machine Learning Specialization
courses.description: Andrew Ng's foundational specialization covering supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, and classification with Python.

courses.title: MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) Fundamentals
courses.description: Covers the fundamentals of operationalizing ML models on Google Cloud: pipelines, model registries, and continuous training.

courses.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty
courses.description: Exam-prep style course covering ML model building, tuning, and deployment on AWS SageMaker and related services.

courses.title: GitHub Actions - The Complete CI/CD Pipeline
courses.description: Covers building automated build, test, and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, including containerized deployments.

courses.title: Python for Everybody Specialization

courses.title: SQL for Data Science
